name: Harosheth
overview: Harosheth is identified in Scripture as the dwelling place of Sisera, the captain of Jabin king of Canaan's army, who reigned in Hazor. This town of Galilee served as Sisera's military base, from which he assembled his formidable force of nine hundred iron chariots. The narrative in Judges highlights Harosheth as the strategic location tied to the defeat of Sisera's host by Barak, underscoring God's sovereignty in delivering His people from oppression.
